asset.name: MotionPrimitive
asset.description: The low-level animated element exposing tokenized transitions and continuous motion values without routing frame-by-frame updates through React state.

requires.reason: Every spacing, size, and radius value resolves to a declared ramp rather than a literal.
Motion policy is resolved through the shared hook so the preference can be overridden and tested.
Enter and exit lifecycle, interruption, and nesting are owned once rather than per animated component.

rationale: The rule this asset exists to enforce: pointer positions, drag offsets, and spring values update DOM style or motion values directly. Frame-rate values in a store is a performance defect that is very hard to remove later.
